title: AI-Protocol V2 Prism Pack Manifest
description: Prism Pack capability contract: a curated bundle of provider routes for cost/latency/balanced routing. Extends the v2 provider manifest ecosystem; references provider ids and model ids from ai-protocol v2 provider manifests. Contract only — no marketplace or registry implementation.

$schema.description: Schema reference URL (must point to schemas/v2/pack.json)

id.description: Stable pack identifier (lowercase, alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores)

protocol_version.description: AI-Protocol version this pack conforms to

description.description: Short summary of pack intent and routing strategy

optimize_default.description: Default routing optimize mode when the consumer does not specify one (aligns with Prism /v1/route/decide)

provider_routes.description: Ordered provider/model routes; lower priority value = higher preference within the same optimize mode

signing_info.description: Optional publisher signature metadata (future registry use; not required for draft packs)

metadata.description: Opaque publisher metadata (tags, docs links, billing hints)

provider.description: Provider id — must match an ai-protocol v2 provider manifest id

model.description: Model id within the provider manifest metadata.models

cost_weight.description: Relative cost weight for balanced optimize mode (0 = ignore cost, 1 = cost-only)

capability_tags.description: Capability tags for filtering (e.g. chat, reasoning, vision)

notes.description: Publisher notes for this route (alias handling, SLA caveats)

public_key_id.description: Key id for verifying the pack manifest signature

signature.description: Base64-encoded detached signature over canonical JSON (registry TBD)
